Trade Show Signs

Canadian Tree Salvation and Rock Bottom Underpinning approached Vinyl Wrap Toronto to design and print their trade show signs. They were both going to exhibit at the 2020 Toronto Home Show in March. This is one of the biggest exhibitions for both companies and they wanted to stand out from the rest of the 100’s of booths.

Vinyl Wrap Toronto has worked with Rock Bottom before, wrapping their trucks and vans. Click Here to view the Truck Wrap we completed last December.

Canadian Tree Salvation was referred to Vinyl Wrap Toronto by another company and we look forward to wrapping more for them in the future. RockBottom Underpinning decided to go with large signs due to them having a large booth. The two main trade show signs are almost 10 feet long and the 2 smaller versions are 8 feet in length. They also asked us to create a wall logo and a floor sticker that they applied themselves.

Canadian Tree Salvation went about their signs slightly differently. They built a wood structure that our installers then applied the vinyl onto. The graphic designs took a photo from the Canadian Tree Salvations Website to create the Win a Japanese Maple Tree sign.

The white round logo for them was printed and applied to plexiglass, the blue backing was to be removed before mounting on the wall. While Canadian Tree Salvation was in the showroom, they enquired about promotional clothing. Our sister company Workwear Toronto offers heat press among other services depending on your company’s needs.

Canadian Tree Salvation wanted their own shirts to be used and done the next day. Workwear Toronto printed the logos and heat-pressed them onto the clothes ready for the trade show along with their signs.

If you are looking to make an impact at your next event, speak to our team at 416-746-1381 or visit us at 24 Ronson Drive, Unit 1, Etobicoke for design ideas and options.
